success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant reschedules the HVAC service from the original date to a new date and notifies the user of the updated appointment details.

cancellation_policy.refund_policy: Full refund if cancelled 24+ hours before service

persona.name: Dr. Emily Novak
persona.bio: Emily Novak teaches linguistics at Indiana University, specializing in syntax and English grammar. She researches how speakers use language in different contexts, publishes in academic journals, and presents at conferences. She also runs the university's writing center and trains tutors in grammatical analysis.
